comparison.objective: Install a circlip in a shaft groove and turn it to verify seating; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Pliers-tip insertion, controlled elastic spreading, axial placement and seating verification versus hex-key use, collar rotation, relocking and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Ring seated without overspread, twist or cocking and verified by rotation; candidate succeeds through repeated controlled carriage stops. Candidate lacks final numeric rebound, overload and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Shared force control and tool use are generic; elastic retaining-ring installation tests a different manipulation capability.
